preconditions.description: The input n must be an integer.
The input n must be less than or equal to 100.

postconditions.description: If n is less than or equal to 0, the function returns an empty string.
If n is positive, the output contains exactly 2n-1 lines.

postconditions.expression: n > 0 and all(len(line) == max(len(l) for l in return_value.splitlines()) for line in return_value.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All lines in the output have the same length, equal to the length of the longest line.
If n is positive, the output is not empty after stripping whitespace.

postconditions.expression: n > 0 and return_value.splitlines()[n-1] == return_value.splitlines()[n-1].strip() and return_value.splitlines()[n-1].strip() == ''.join(str(i % 10) for i in list(range(1, n+1)) + list(range(n-1, 0, -1)))
postconditions.description: The middle line (nth line) contains the sequence from 1 to n and back to 1, with digits modulo 10.

postconditions.expression: n > 0 and all(return_value.splitlines()[i].strip() == ''.join(str(j % 10) for j in list(range(1, i+2)) + list(range(i, 0, -1))) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For the first n lines, each line i (0-indexed) contains the sequence from 1 to i+1 and back to 1, with digits modulo 10.

postconditions.expression: n > 0 and all(return_value.splitlines()[i].strip() == ''.join(str(j % 10) for j in list(range(1, 2*n-i)) + list(range(2*n-i-2, 0, -1))) for i in range(n, 2*n-1))
postconditions.description: For the remaining lines after the middle, each line i (0-indexed) contains the sequence from 1 to 2n-i-1 and back to 1, with digits modulo 10.
